_readme: Art rules for scripts/generate-assets.js and scripts/style-board.js. styleLead/style = the CURRENT CANDIDATE look (stylized 3D, low detail) until the user locks a style. Camera angles are defined once in angles; itemTypes say which angle each type uses plus its presentation and never-draw list. materials/materialTags and factions are chosen from item tags. Negatives only ever add up; keep the shared negative to things every asset must avoid.

outline._note: Code-drawn outline added in post-processing (after cleanup): identical on every icon. px is at the 1024 render size. User chose 3px on 2026-11-14 (16 was far too bold; 4-5 also tested).

cleanup._note: Post-processing per item type, run after background removal. find = SAM 3 text prompt; action: void (dark empty opening), erase (make transparent), cutBelow (straight cut just above the top of the detection, e.g. ankles). maxArea = largest plausible detection as a fraction of the image; anything bigger is treated as a bad detection and ignored (the quality gate then decides). verify = things that type must never show; checked again on the cleaned icon, and a hit rejects the variant and re-renders on a new seed (up to maxAttempts). If every attempt fails, the best one is kept and flagged in meta.json and the review page. requireSkin: a body-part detection only counts if at least minSkin of its pixels are skin-toned, because SAM labels an empty dark face-shaped hood opening as a face (and even as nose/mouth). Every gated item is also checked for multiple separate objects (islands bigger than minIslandArea). minStructure: a region with 0% skin still counts as a body part if its light/dark structure (mean abs Laplacian inside the mask, rim excluded) is >= this - catches faces in deep shadow. Measured 2026-11-14: shadowed face 0.93, empty voids 0.11-0.68 (narrow margin, provisional).

singleObject._note: Item types whose icon must be ONE object: the gate rejects renders with more than one separate shape. exceptSubtypes lists subcategories that are naturally several pieces.

familyBases._note: Approved base icon per shape family (archetype). Items of that archetype render image-to-image from the base start image (raw render, no outline, flattened on grey, converted to NEUTRAL GREY so the base gives shape only and colour comes from each item spec - at denoise 0.6 a coloured base kept its colour: riverwillow came out with pine bark), so a family shares one shape and only its identity cues change. denoise = how far members may move from the base. Override with --from, disable with --no-base.

angles._note: Each camera angle is defined ONCE. Helmet, chest and legs all use armorFront so equipped pieces line up as one outfit; back is the reverse view.

armorFront.view: three-quarter front view, the item turned about 15 degrees so its front faces slightly toward the viewer's left, camera level with the item
armorFront.avoid: side view, profile view, back view, rear view, top-down view

backRear.view: three-quarter rear view showing the back of the item, turned about 15 degrees the opposite way so its back faces slightly toward the viewer's right, camera level with the item
backRear.avoid: front view, front opening, face, chest

bootSide.view: side view, angled about 15 degrees toward the viewer, camera level with the item
bootSide.avoid: front view, back view, top-down view, soles facing the viewer

gloveTop.view: seen from slightly above, tilted about 15 degrees from directly overhead
gloveTop.avoid: side view, profile view, front view, palms facing the viewer

weaponSide.view: side view of the full length, angled about 15 degrees toward the viewer, lying along a shallow diagonal from lower left to upper right
weaponSide.avoid: front view, end-on view, top-down view, extreme foreshortening

resting.view: three-quarter view from slightly above, as if resting on an unseen surface, camera angled about 30 degrees down
resting.avoid: top-down flat lay, straight side view, extreme close-up

creatureSide.view: side view, angled about 15 degrees toward the viewer, whole body visible, head toward the left
creatureSide.avoid: front view, top-down view, back view, extreme foreshortening

backgrounds._note: Region backgrounds. Format derived from the current Cradle background (assets/backgrounds/regions/region_the_scar_01.png - used for FORMAT only, never as a style input): 1024x1024 square, shown with background-size: cover / center under translucent UI panels with a 2-5px blur, so the centre carries the scene and both edges are cropped on phones (tall) and the top/bottom on desktops (wide). Composition: one clear focal landmark in the middle distance at the centre, leading lines (path, river, shoreline) into hazy depth, foreground framing on the left and right edges, brighter centre and darker edges.
backgrounds.composition: wide establishing landscape view at eye level, centered symmetrical composition, one clear focal landmark in the middle distance at the center of the image, leading lines drawing the eye into the distance, foreground framing elements on the left and right edges, layered depth receding into soft atmospheric haze, brighter center and gently darker edges, no characters
